_comment: Titles and meta descriptions for the merchandise pages — the lines that appear in a search result. pages: one entry per fixed page. templates: the pattern for the generated ones, where {name} is the product or family and {n} the number of products. Lengths must stay inside the build audit: title 15-65, description 50-170.

chooser.title: PAMUUC | Custom uniforms and branded merchandise
chooser.description: Uniforms developed around how your team works, and branded merchandise you personalise yourself. Two services from one studio in Barcelona.

merch.title: Branded merchandise for companies | PAMUUC
merch.description: Custom apparel for staff, events and company merchandise. Choose the garment, the cloth, the colour and the personalisation, and we quote it by hand.

products.title: All branded apparel you can personalise | PAMUUC
products.description: Every garment in the catalogue, compared by what actually decides it: cloth weight, the personalisation it takes and the quantity it starts from.

collections.title: Branded merchandise by product family | PAMUUC
collections.description: Seven families of branded clothing. Open one to compare the products in it, the quantities they start from and the personalisation each garment carries.

method.title: Personalisation methods and artwork | PAMUUC
method.description: Embroidery, screen print, transfer and embossing — what each one suits, what it costs to set up, and the artwork each method needs from you.

howto.title: How to order branded merchandise | PAMUUC
howto.description: From choosing a garment to approving the quote: what happens at each step, what we need from you, and how long the whole thing takes.

merchhelp.title: Help with a merchandise request | PAMUUC
merchhelp.description: Answers on quantities, artwork, delivery and pricing for branded merchandise — and a way to ask us something the page does not cover.

quote.title: Request a merchandise quote | PAMUUC
quote.description: Tell us the garment, the quantity and the personalisation, and a person prices it by hand. Nothing is ordered and nothing is charged until you approve it.

about.title: About PAMUUC | Barcelona uniform studio
about.description: A Barcelona studio making uniforms and branded clothing since 2019, for teams who wear their work every day. Who we are and how we work.

contact.title: Contact PAMUUC | Barcelona
contact.description: Tell us what you need and one of us reads it properly. Custom uniforms, branded merchandise, or a question about an order already under way.

search.title: Search branded merchandise | PAMUUC
search.description: Search the catalogue of branded apparel by garment, cloth weight, colour and the personalisation each product will take.

collection.title: Branded {name} for companies | PAMUUC
collection.description: {n} {products} in {name}, compared on the same basis: cloth weight, the personalisation each takes, and the quantity it starts from.

build.title: Choose {name} by what you need | PAMUUC
build.description: Answer four questions — who wears it, the fit, the weight and the finish — and the {name} in the catalogue narrow to the one that suits your team.
